description: Expanded JTWP server rules and advisory punishment guidance. Admins select a category during review. A case may remain valid even when no existing rule fully covers the conduct.

R001.title: No Racism
R001.summary: Racist language, conduct, imagery, or targeted behavior is prohibited.
R001.details: Players may not demean, target, exclude, threaten, or harass another person or group based on race, ethnicity, nationality, ancestry, or perceived racial background.
examples: Racist stereotypes directed at another person
Racist usernames, images, signs, voice chat, or messages
Encouraging hostility or discrimination toward a racial or ethnic group
mitigating_factors: Single isolated incident with credible evidence of misunderstanding

R002.title: No Sexist Behavior
R002.summary: Sexist, misogynistic, or gender-based harassment is prohibited.
R002.details: Players may not demean, harass, intimidate, or target another person because of sex, gender, gender identity, or perceived gender.
examples: Repeated unwanted sexual comments directed at another player
Targeting or excluding someone because of gender
mitigating_factors: One isolated comment without targeted harassment

R003.title: Treat Other Players With Respect
R003.summary: Players are expected to interact with others respectfully.
R003.details: Disagreement, competition, and ordinary trash talk are not automatically violations. Repeated personal attacks, targeted hostility, intimidation, or deliberately abusive conduct may be moderated.
examples: Continuing abusive conduct after being asked to stop
Targeting one player across multiple rounds
Deliberately provoking another player to cause conflict

R004.title: No Bullying
R004.summary: Repeated or coordinated bullying of another player is prohibited.
R004.details: Players may not repeatedly target, humiliate, intimidate, isolate, or encourage others to gang up on another player.
examples: Following a player between sessions to continue harassment
Encouraging a group to target one person
Repeated intimidation through voice or text
aggravating_factors: Victim asks offender to stop and conduct continues

R005.title: No Intentional Team Killing
R005.summary: Deliberate team killing or repeated intentional team damage is prohibited.
R005.details: Accidental team damage can happen during normal gameplay. Moderation should focus on deliberate, retaliatory, repeated, or clearly reckless team killing.
examples: Using explosives specifically to kill teammates

R006.title: Do Not Intentionally Impact Server Performance
R006.summary: Players may not knowingly attempt to degrade, overload, crash, or destabilize the server.
R006.details: Deliberately creating excessive load, abusing objects, exploiting map behavior, or repeatedly performing actions known to cause lag, crashes, or instability is prohibited.
examples: Repeatedly using a known lag exploit
Continuing performance-impacting behavior after being warned
mitigating_factors: Unknown bug triggered during normal play

R007.title: Do Not Disclose Other Players' Private Information
R007.summary: Players may not disclose, threaten to disclose, or solicit another person's private identifying information.
R007.details: Posting, sharing, threatening to share, or encouraging others to obtain private personal information about another player is prohibited.
examples: Sharing a private phone number or email address
evidence_guidance: Preserved evidence with sensitive information redacted from public logs
mitigating_factors: Information was already intentionally public and not used for harassment
Evidence does not establish the accused disclosed it

R008.title: No Cheating or Unfair-Advantage Software
R008.summary: External software, cheats, unauthorized modifications, or automation used for an unfair gameplay advantage are prohibited.
R008.details: Players may not knowingly use tools or modifications intended to provide information, aim, movement, automation, visibility, or other competitive capabilities unavailable through normal gameplay.
examples: External tools providing hidden gameplay information
mitigating_factors: Legitimate accessibility or hardware behavior incorrectly suspected

R009.title: No Gore or Sexually Explicit Material
R009.summary: Graphic real-world gore and sexually explicit material may not be posted or displayed through JTWP servers.
R009.details: Players may not deliberately upload, display, transmit, link, or expose others to pornographic, sexually explicit, or graphic real-world gore content through server-supported systems.
examples: Repeated attempts to expose players to prohibited content
evidence_guidance: Screenshots with sensitive content safely redacted where possible
mitigating_factors: Content was not actually explicit after review

R010.title: No Game-Mode Manipulation for Unfair Advantage
R010.summary: Players may not intentionally manipulate game-mode systems, bugs, or unintended mechanics for an unfair advantage.
R010.details: Using game-mode logic, roles, team systems, economy systems, bugs, or unintended mechanics in a knowingly abusive way to gain an unfair advantage is prohibited.
examples: Abusing role mechanics to bypass restrictions
Repeated use of a known exploit

R011.title: Do Not Threaten Other Players
R011.summary: Credible or targeted threats of serious harm are prohibited.
R011.details: Players may not threaten violence, stalking, doxxing, or other serious harm in a way reasonably understood as targeted intimidation.
examples: Threatening to stalk or locate another player
mitigating_factors: Insufficient evidence of what was actually said

R012.title: Do Not Deliberately Stop Other Players From Enjoying the Server
R012.summary: Deliberately and repeatedly interfering with other players' reasonable use or enjoyment of the server is prohibited.
R012.details: This rule covers intentional disruptive conduct that may not fit another specific rule but is clearly aimed at ruining or preventing normal gameplay for others.
examples: Repeatedly blocking a player solely to disrupt them
Following someone solely to interfere with gameplay
Sabotaging normal gameplay without a legitimate game-mode purpose

R013.title: No Spam or Deliberate Annoyance
R013.summary: Repeated spam or deliberate communication disruption is prohibited.
R013.details: Players may not repeatedly flood messages, voice, sounds, commands, or other communication systems in a way intended to disrupt or annoy others.
examples: Continuing spam after being asked to stop

R014.title: No Slurs or Other Hate Speech
R014.summary: Slurs and hate speech targeting people based on identity or perceived identity are prohibited.
R014.details: Players may not use slurs, dehumanizing group-based language, or content that promotes hatred or hostility toward people because of race, ethnicity, nationality, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, disability, or similar protected or marginalized identity.
mitigating_factors: Dispute over exact wording where no reliable record exists
